    <h2>{`What is a Page?`}</h2>
    <p>{`A `}<strong parentName="p">{`Page`}</strong>{` in Graphite is a fundamental building block that represents a distinct view or screen in your application. It serves as a container that orchestrates UI components, data sources, and business logic to create a cohesive user experience.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Definition and Purpose`}</h3>
    <p>{`A Page is a declarative XML component that:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Defines a navigable view`}</strong>{` in your application with a unique route/path`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Organizes UI components`}</strong>{` into a structured layout`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Manages data sources`}</strong>{` specific to that view`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Handles user interactions`}</strong>{` through controllers and event handlers`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Controls lifecycle`}</strong>{` of components within its scope`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Maintains state`}</strong>{` that persists during the page’s lifetime`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p>{`Think of a Page as a self-contained module that encapsulates everything needed to display and interact with a specific part of your application.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Role in Application Architecture`}</h3>
    <p>{`Pages sit at the heart of Graphite’s component hierarchy:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{}}>{`Application
  └── Pages (collection)
      └── Page (individual view)
          ├── Datasources (page-specific data)
          ├── Controllers (page logic)
          ├── State (page variables)
          ├── UI Components (layout & widgets)
          └── Dialogs (page-specific modals)
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Key Architectural Roles:`}</strong></p>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Navigation Target`}</strong>{`: Each page has a unique path that users navigate to`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Scope Boundary`}</strong>{`: Pages define the scope for datasources, state, and controllers`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Lifecycle Manager`}</strong>{`: Pages control when components are initialized, shown, hidden, and destroyed`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Event Hub`}</strong>{`: Pages coordinate events between UI components, datasources, and controllers`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`State Container`}</strong>{`: Pages maintain their own state that can be accessed by child components`}</li>
    </ol>
    <h3>{`How Pages Relate to Other Components`}</h3>

    <h2>{`Page Life Cycle Events`}</h2>
    <p>{`Pages have a well-defined lifecycle with events that fire at specific stages. Understanding these events is crucial for implementing proper initialization, cleanup, and state management.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Lifecycle Event Flow`}</h3>
    <p>{`When navigating between pages, events fire in this order:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{}}>{`User navigates to new page
    ↓
1. oldPage.pagePaused()          ← Current page is being left
    ↓
2. newPage.pageInitialized()     ← New page created (first time only)
    ↓
3. newPage.pageResumed()         ← New page becomes active
    ↓
4. Process datasource dynamic properties
    ↓
5. Pre-load datasources (if any)
    ↓
6. Render page UI
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Core Lifecycle Events`}</h3>

    <p><strong parentName="p">{`What You Can Do`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Access and store `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`page`}</inlineCode>{` and `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`app`}</inlineCode>{` references`}</li>

    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`class WorkOrderDetailController {
  pageInitialized(page, app) {
    // Store references for later use

    this.app = app;
    
    console.log('Page initialized:', page.id);
    console.log('Page path:', page.path);

    }

export default WorkOrderDetailController;

    <h4>{`2. `}<inlineCode parentName="h4">{`pageResumed(page, app)`}</inlineCode></h4>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When`}</strong>{`: Called `}<strong parentName="p">{`every time`}</strong>{` the page becomes active, including the first time.`}</p>

    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`class WorkOrderDetailController {
  pageInitialized(page, app) {
    this.page = page;
    this.app = app;
    this.woDS = page.datasources.woDS;
  }
  
  pageResumed(page, app) {
    console.log('Page resumed:', page.id);
    
    // Get the work order number from URL parameters
    const wonum = page.params.wonum;
    
    if (wonum) {
      // Update breadcrumb with work order number
      page.updatePageStack({
        label: \`Work Order \${wonum}\`,
        path: \`/workorders/\${wonum}\`
      });
      
      // Load the specific work order
      console.log('Loading work order:', wonum);
      
      // Set loading state
      page.state.isLoading = true;
      
      // Load datasource with filter
      this.woDS.load({
        where: \`wonum="\${wonum}"\`
      }).then(() => {
        // Update page state after successful load
        page.state.isLoading = false;
        page.state.hasData = this.woDS.state.itemCount > 0;
        
        if (page.state.hasData) {
          const wo = this.woDS.get(0);
          page.state.pageTitle = \`Work Order \${wo.wonum}\`;
          
          // Update breadcrumb with full details
          page.updatePageStack({
            label: \`WO \${wo.wonum} - \${wo.description}\`,
            path: \`/workorders/\${wonum}\`
          });
        }
      }).catch(error => {
        console.error('Failed to load work order:', error);
        page.state.isLoading = false;
        page.state.loadError = error.message;
        
        this.app.toast('Failed to load work order', 'error');
      });
    }
    
    // Reset edit mode when returning to page
    page.state.editMode = false;
    
    // Check if we need to refresh data
    if (this.app.state.dataChanged) {
      this.woDS.forceReload();
      this.app.state.dataChanged = false;
    }
  }
}

export default WorkOrderDetailController;
`}</code></pre>
    <h4>{`3. `}<inlineCode parentName="h4">{`pagePaused(page, app)`}</inlineCode></h4>

    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`class WorkOrderDetailController {
  pageInitialized(page, app) {
    this.page = page;
    this.app = app;
    this.woDS = page.datasources.woDS;
    this.autoSaveTimer = null;
  }
  
  pageResumed(page, app) {
    // Start auto-save timer
    this.autoSaveTimer = setInterval(() => {
      this.autoSave();
    }, 30000); // Every 30 seconds
  }
  
  pagePaused(page, app) {
    console.log('Page paused:', page.id);
    
    // Stop auto-save timer
    if (this.autoSaveTimer) {
      clearInterval(this.autoSaveTimer);
      this.autoSaveTimer = null;
    }
    
    // Check for unsaved changes
    if (this.woDS.state.hasChanges) {
      // Save draft
      const draftData = {
        wonum: page.params.wonum,
        changes: this.woDS.getChanges(),
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
      };
      
      // Store in local storage
      localStorage.setItem(
        \`wo_draft_\${page.params.wonum}\`,
        JSON.stringify(draftData)
      );
      
      console.log('Draft saved for work order:', page.params.wonum);
    }
    
    // Store scroll position
    page.state.scrollPosition = window.scrollY;
    
    // Cancel any pending operations
    if (this.pendingRequest) {
      this.pendingRequest.abort();
      this.pendingRequest = null;
    }
    
    // Clean up any page-specific resources
    page.state.isEditing = false;
  }
  
  autoSave() {
    if (this.woDS.state.hasChanges) {
      console.log('Auto-saving changes...');
      // Implement auto-save logic
    }
  }
}

export default WorkOrderDetailController;
`}</code></pre>
    <h4>{`4. `}<inlineCode parentName="h4">{`onPageSerialize({page})`}</inlineCode>{` and `}<inlineCode parentName="h4">{`onPageDeserialize({page})`}</inlineCode></h4>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`When`}</strong>{`: Called when the page state needs to be saved or restored.`}</p>

      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`onPageSerialize`}</inlineCode>{`: Before page state is saved (e.g., for mobile offline sync)`}</li>

    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Purpose`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Control what page state is persisted`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Transform state before saving`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Restore state after loading`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Parameters`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Object containing `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`page`}</inlineCode>{`: The page instance`}</li>

    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Example`}</strong>{`:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`class WorkOrderDetailController {
  onPageSerialize({page}) {
    console.log('Serializing page state');
    
    // Add custom data to be serialized
    page.state.serializationTimestamp = new Date().toISOString();
    
    // Clean up any non-serializable data
    delete page.state.temporaryData;
  }
  
  onPageDeserialize({page}) {
    console.log('Deserializing page state');
    
    // Restore or transform state after loading
    if (page.state.serializationTimestamp) {
      const savedTime = new Date(page.state.serializationTimestamp);
      const now = new Date();
      const hoursSinceSave = (now - savedTime) / (1000 * 60 * 60);
      
      // If data is old, mark for refresh
      if (hoursSinceSave > 24) {
        page.state.needsRefresh = true;
      }
    }
  }
}

export default WorkOrderDetailController;
`}</code></pre>

    <h3>{`Example 1: Page with Multiple Controllers`}</h3>

    <h4>{`XML Definition`}</h4>

  <!-- Multiple controllers for different responsibilities -->
  <controller src="WorkOrderDetailController.js"/>
  <controller src="ValidationController.js"/>
  <controller src="NotificationController.js"/>
  
  <states>

      </schema>
    </maximo-datasource>

</page>
`}</code></pre>
    <h4>{`Controller 1: Main Page Logic`}</h4>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`// WorkOrderDetailController.js
class WorkOrderDetailController {
  pageInitialized(page, app) {
    this.page = page;
    this.app = app;
    this.woDS = page.datasources.woDS;
  }
  
  pageResumed(page, app) {
    const wonum = page.params.wonum;
    if (wonum) {
      // Update breadcrumb
      page.updatePageStack({
        label: \`Work Order \${wonum}\`,
        path: \`/workorders/\${wonum}\`
      });
      
      page.state.isLoading = true;
      this.woDS.load({ where: \`wonum="\${wonum}"\` })
        .then(() => {
          page.state.isLoading = false;
          
          // Update breadcrumb with full details
          const wo = this.woDS.get(0);
          if (wo) {
            page.updatePageStack({
              label: \`WO \${wo.wonum} - \${wo.description}\`,
              path: \`/workorders/\${wonum}\`
            });
          }
        });
    }
  }
  
  saveWorkOrder() {
    // Validation will be handled by ValidationController
    this.woDS.save()
      .then(() => {
        // Notification will be handled by NotificationController
        this.app.eventManager.emit('workOrderSaved');
      });
  }
}

export default WorkOrderDetailController;
`}</code></pre>
    <h4>{`Controller 2: Validation Logic`}</h4>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`// ValidationController.js
class ValidationController {
  pageInitialized(page, app) {
    this.page = page;
    this.woDS = page.datasources.woDS;
    
    // Listen for value changes
    this.woDS.on('value-changed', (event) => {
      this.validateField(event.field, event.newValue);
    });
  }
  
  validateField(field, value) {
    const errors = {...this.page.state.validationErrors};
    
    if (field === 'description') {
      if (!value || value.trim() === '') {
        errors.description = 'Description is required';
      } else if (value.length < 10) {
        errors.description = 'Description must be at least 10 characters';
      } else {
        delete errors.description;
      }
    }
    
    this.page.state.validationErrors = errors;
  }
}

export default ValidationController;
`}</code></pre>
    <h4>{`Controller 3: Notification Logic`}</h4>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`// NotificationController.js
class NotificationController {
  pageInitialized(page, app) {
    this.app = app;
    
    // Listen for custom events
    app.eventManager.on('workOrderSaved', () => {
      this.showSuccessNotification();
    });
  }
  
  showSuccessNotification() {
    this.app.toast('Work order saved successfully', 'success');
  }
}

export default NotificationController;
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Example 2: Complete Work Order Detail Page`}</h3>
    <p>{`This example shows a full implementation with comprehensive lifecycle management.`}</p>
    <h4>{`XML Definition`}</h4>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<page id="workOrderDetail" 
      path="workorders/:wonum" 
      controller="WorkOrderDetailController">
  
  <states>
    <state id="isLoading" value="false"/>
    <state id="isEditing" value="false"/>
    <state id="hasChanges" value="false"/>
    <state id="pageTitle" value="Work Order Details"/>
    <state id="lastRefresh" value=""/>
  </states>
  
  <datasources>
    <maximo-datasource 
      id="woDS" 
      object-structure="MXAPIWODETAIL"
      selection-mode="single">
      <schema>
        <attribute name="wonum"/>
        <attribute name="description"/>
        <attribute name="status"/>
        <attribute name="worktype"/>
        <attribute name="assetnum"/>
        <attribute name="location"/>
      </schema>
    </maximo-datasource>
  </datasources>
  
  <page-header>
    <label label="{page.state.pageTitle}"/>
    <button-group>
      <button 
        label="Edit" 
        on-click="toggleEditMode"
        disabled="{page.state.isEditing}"/>
      <button 
        label="Save" 
        on-click="saveChanges"
        disabled="{!page.state.hasChanges}"/>
      <button 
        label="Refresh" 
        on-click="refreshData"/>
    </button-group>
  </page-header>
  
  <loading show="{page.state.isLoading}"/>
  
  <box direction="column" padding="medium">
    <field label="Work Order" value="{woDS.item.wonum}"/>
    <smart-input 
      attribute="description" 
      datasource="woDS"
      readonly="{!page.state.isEditing}"/>
    <smart-input 
      attribute="status" 
      datasource="woDS"
      readonly="{!page.state.isEditing}"/>
  </box>
  
</page>
`}</code></pre>
    <h4>{`Controller Implementation`}</h4>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`class WorkOrderDetailController {
  constructor() {
    this.autoSaveTimer = null;
    this.refreshInterval = null;
  }

  pageInitialized(page, app) {
    console.log('Page initialized:', page.id);
    
    this.page = page;
    this.app = app;
    this.woDS = page.datasources.woDS;
    
    // Set up datasource change listener
    this.woDS.on('value-changed', () => {
      page.state.hasChanges = this.woDS.state.hasChanges;
    });
  }

  pageResumed(page, app) {
    console.log('Page resumed');
    
    const wonum = page.params.wonum;
    
    if (!wonum) {
      app.toast('No work order specified', 'error');
      app.navigateBack();
      return;
    }
    
    // Update breadcrumb initially
    page.updatePageStack({
      label: \`Work Order \${wonum}\`,
      path: \`/workorders/\${wonum}\`
    });
    
    this.loadWorkOrder(wonum);
    this.checkForDraft(wonum);
    this.startAutoRefresh();
    
    page.state.isEditing = false;
  }

  pagePaused(page, app) {
    console.log('Page paused');
    
    this.stopAutoRefresh();
    
    if (this.woDS.state.hasChanges) {
      this.saveDraft();
      app.toast('Draft saved', 'info');
    }
    
    if (this.autoSaveTimer) {
      clearInterval(this.autoSaveTimer);
      this.autoSaveTimer = null;
    }
  }

  loadWorkOrder(wonum) {
    this.page.state.isLoading = true;
    
    this.woDS.load({ where: \`wonum="\${wonum}"\` })
      .then(() => {
        const wo = this.woDS.get(0);
        this.page.state.pageTitle = \`WO \${wo.wonum}\`;
        this.page.state.lastRefresh = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
        
        // Update breadcrumb with full details
        this.page.updatePageStack({
          label: \`WO \${wo.wonum} - \${wo.description}\`,
          path: \`/workorders/\${wonum}\`
        });
      })
      .catch(error => {
        console.error('Failed to load:', error);
        this.app.toast('Failed to load work order', 'error');
      })
      .finally(() => {
        this.page.state.isLoading = false;
      });
  }

  checkForDraft(wonum) {
    const draftKey = \`wo_draft_\${wonum}\`;
    const draftData = localStorage.getItem(draftKey);
    
    if (draftData) {
      this.app.showDialog('restoreDraft', {
        onRestore: () => {
          this.restoreDraft(JSON.parse(draftData));
          localStorage.removeItem(draftKey);
        },
        onDiscard: () => {
          localStorage.removeItem(draftKey);
        }
      });
    }
  }

  saveDraft() {
    const draftData = {
      wonum: this.page.params.wonum,
      changes: this.woDS.getChanges(),
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    
    localStorage.setItem(
      \`wo_draft_\${this.page.params.wonum}\`,
      JSON.stringify(draftData)
    );
  }

  startAutoRefresh() {
    this.refreshInterval = setInterval(() => {
      this.refreshData();
    }, 5 * 60 * 1000); // 5 minutes
  }

  stopAutoRefresh() {
    if (this.refreshInterval) {
      clearInterval(this.refreshInterval);
      this.refreshInterval = null;
    }
  }

  toggleEditMode() {
    this.page.state.isEditing = !this.page.state.isEditing;
  }

  saveChanges() {
    this.page.state.isLoading = true;
    
    this.woDS.save()
      .then(() => {
        this.page.state.hasChanges = false;
        this.page.state.isEditing = false;
        this.app.toast('Changes saved', 'success');
        
        localStorage.removeItem(\`wo_draft_\${this.page.params.wonum}\`);
      })
      .catch(error => {
        console.error('Save failed:', error);
        this.app.toast('Failed to save', 'error');
      })
      .finally(() => {
        this.page.state.isLoading = false;
      });
  }

  refreshData() {
    this.woDS.forceReload()
      .then(() => {
        this.page.state.lastRefresh = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
        this.app.toast('Data refreshed', 'success');
      });
  }
}

export default WorkOrderDetailController;
`}</code></pre>
    <hr></hr>
    <h2>{`Best Practices`}</h2>
    <h3>{`✅ Do’s`}</h3>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Use the `}<inlineCode parentName="strong">{`controller`}</inlineCode>{` attribute for single controllers`}</strong></p>
        <pre parentName="li"><code parentName="pre" {...{
            "className": "language-xml"
          }}>{`<page id="myPage" controller="MyPageController">
`}</code></pre>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Use `}<inlineCode parentName="strong">{`<controller>`}</inlineCode>{` components for multiple controllers`}</strong></p>
        <pre parentName="li"><code parentName="pre" {...{
            "className": "language-xml"
          }}>{`<page id="myPage">
  <controller src="MainController.js"/>
  <controller src="ValidationController.js"/>
</page>
`}</code></pre>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Use `}<inlineCode parentName="strong">{`pageInitialized`}</inlineCode>{` for one-time setup`}</strong></p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul">{`Store references to page, app, and datasources`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul">{`Initialize state defaults`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul">{`Set up event listeners`}</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Use `}<inlineCode parentName="strong">{`pageResumed`}</inlineCode>{` for data loading and breadcrumb updates`}</strong></p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul">{`Load or reload datasources`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul">{`Check navigation parameters`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul">{`Update breadcrumb using `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`page.updatePageStack()`}</inlineCode></li>
          <li parentName="ul">{`Refresh data when returning to the page`}</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Use `}<inlineCode parentName="strong">{`pagePaused`}</inlineCode>{` for cleanup`}</strong></p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul">{`Save drafts`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul">{`Stop timers and intervals`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul">{`Cancel pending requests`}</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Keep lifecycle methods synchronous`}</strong></p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul">{`Don’t declare lifecycle methods as `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`async`}</inlineCode></li>
          <li parentName="ul">{`Use promises without await at the method level`}</li>
        </ul>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Store references in `}<inlineCode parentName="strong">{`pageInitialized`}</inlineCode></strong></p>
        <pre parentName="li"><code parentName="pre" {...{
            "className": "language-js"
          }}>{`pageInitialized(page, app) {
  this.page = page;
  this.app = app;
  this.myDS = page.datasources.myDS;
}
`}</code></pre>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Update breadcrumb in `}<inlineCode parentName="strong">{`pageResumed`}</inlineCode></strong></p>
        <pre parentName="li"><code parentName="pre" {...{
            "className": "language-js"
          }}>{`pageResumed(page, app) {
  page.updatePageStack({
    label: 'My Page Title',
    path: page.path
  });
}
`}</code></pre>
      </li>
    </ol>
    <h3>{`❌ Don’ts`}</h3>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Don’t declare lifecycle methods as async`}</strong></p>
        <pre parentName="li"><code parentName="pre" {...{
            "className": "language-js"
          }}>{`// ❌ Bad
async pageResumed(page, app) { }

// ✅ Good
pageResumed(page, app) {
  this.loadData(); // async method called inside
}
`}</code></pre>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Don’t load data in `}<inlineCode parentName="strong">{`pageInitialized`}</inlineCode></strong></p>
        <pre parentName="li"><code parentName="pre" {...{
            "className": "language-js"
          }}>{`// ❌ Bad
pageInitialized(page, app) {
  this.myDS.load();
}

// ✅ Good
pageResumed(page, app) {
  this.myDS.load();
}
`}</code></pre>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Don’t use `}<inlineCode parentName="strong">{`getPageStack()`}</inlineCode>{` - use `}<inlineCode parentName="strong">{`page.updatePageStack()`}</inlineCode>{` instead`}</strong></p>
        <pre parentName="li"><code parentName="pre" {...{
            "className": "language-js"
          }}>{`// ❌ Bad - getPageStack is not the correct API
getPageStack(stack, page) {
  stack.push({label: 'Title', path: '/path'});
}

// ✅ Good - use page.updatePageStack()
pageResumed(page, app) {
  page.updatePageStack({
    label: 'Title',
    path: '/path'
  });
}
`}</code></pre>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Don’t perform long-running operations in `}<inlineCode parentName="strong">{`pagePaused`}</inlineCode></strong></p>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Don’t assume page will be destroyed after `}<inlineCode parentName="strong">{`pagePaused`}</inlineCode></strong></p>
      </li>
      <li parentName="ol">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Don’t navigate in `}<inlineCode parentName="strong">{`pageInitialized`}</inlineCode></strong></p>
      </li>
    </ol>
    <hr></hr>
    <h2>{`Summary`}</h2>
    <p>{`Pages are the fundamental building blocks of Graphite applications. Key takeaways:`}</p>
    <ol>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Pages define views`}</strong>{`: Each page represents a distinct screen with its own route`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Controller flexibility`}</strong>{`: Use `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`controller`}</inlineCode>{` attribute for single controllers, `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`<controller>`}</inlineCode>{` components for multiple`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Lifecycle is predictable`}</strong>{`: Events fire in a consistent order`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Use the right event`}</strong>{`: `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`pageInitialized`}</inlineCode>{` for setup, `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`pageResumed`}</inlineCode>{` for loading, `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`pagePaused`}</inlineCode>{` for cleanup`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Keep it synchronous`}</strong>{`: Don’t use async lifecycle methods`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Manage state properly`}</strong>{`: Use page state for UI-driven values`}</li>
      <li parentName="ol"><strong parentName="li">{`Update breadcrumbs`}</strong>{`: Use `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`page.updatePageStack()`}</inlineCode>{` in `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`pageResumed`}</inlineCode>{` to customize breadcrumb navigation`}</li>
    </ol>
    <p>{`By understanding pages and their lifecycle, you can build robust, maintainable Graphite applications with proper initialization, data loading, and cleanup.`}</p>

    </MDXLayout>;
